description: Change a song made here in this chat, split it into stems, or keep every version.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with music enabled and an available Stack music model; this conversation also holds a song made here

author: MaiPai

examples: change the chorus to be about waffles

description.description: Genre, mood, instruments and original voice, based on the request. Never claim a song exists without calling this tool.

lyrics.description: Write the lyrics yourself with [Verse] and [Chorus] tags. The words you write are the words that are sung and the person will see them. Omit for an instrumental.

bpm.description: Optional tempo in beats per minute.

key.description: Optional. A key such as C major or F# minor.

imitates_real_voice.description: Set true when the person asks to sound like a named real singer or another real identifiable person. Home refuses copying real voices. Use an original voice for a similar style instead.

track.description: Use latest for the selected song in this chat, or an exact file id of a version made here. Uploaded audio is never accepted.

change.description: The change the person asked for.

section.description: A section tag in the stored lyrics, such as chorus or verse 2. For a rewrite, give this or explicit from_s and to_s.

from_s.description: Start of the section or trim in seconds.

to_s.description: End of the section or trim in seconds.

seconds.description: For extend: seconds to add. For fade: fade length. For remake or variation: total length.

strength.description: How much a cover changes the style. Default 0.6.
